title: Pure Amazement
summary: Amazement cards and the Amaze Attraction Normal Traps they Set and equip, plus generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Every Attraction Trap equips to an Amazement monster you control or a face-up monster the opponent controls, applying a different effect depending on whose monster wears the ride.

summary.title: Starters
points: Amazing Time Ticket pays 800 LP: on your turn it adds any Amazement card from the Deck to the hand, and on the opponent's turn it Sets an Amaze Attraction Trap from the Deck that can be activated that turn.
Amazement Attendant Comica Sets an Attraction Trap directly from the Deck on Normal Summon, and moves one of your equipped Attractions to a different valid monster as a Quick Effect.
Amazement Assistant Delia reveals an Attraction in hand to Special Summon itself, and sends an Attraction from your hand or field to the GY to Set another directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Amazing Time Ticket or Comica
steps: Normal Summon Amazement Attendant Comica to Set Amaze Attraction Horror House or Cyclo-Coaster from the Deck.
Activate Amazing Time Ticket to search Amazement Administrator Arlekino or Amazement Abomination Arlekino (or Amazement Precious Park).
Special Summon Amazement Abomination Arlekino while you control an Amazement monster to search Amazement Family Faces.
On the opponent's turn, flip your Set Attraction Trap to trigger Administrator Arlekino from the hand, then equip another Attraction from the Deck to an opposing monster.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: The Arlekinos & Management
summary.text: Amazement Administrator Arlekino Special Summons itself from the hand whenever any Trap Card is activated, equips an Attraction Trap from the Deck to an opposing monster whenever the opponent Normal or Special Summons, and banishes Attractions from your GY to destroy that many cards on the field. Amazement Abomination Arlekino Special Summons itself while you control an Amazement monster, searches Amazement Family Faces (which sends an opponent's monster equipped with your Attraction Trap to take control of it and make it an Amazement monster), and tags out on the opponent's turn into Administrator Arlekino from the Deck while reducing an opposing monster's ATK to 0.

summary.title: Attraction Lineup & Field Spell
points: Amaze Attraction Horror House negates an opposing monster's effects for the turn when equipped to your Amazement, or flips the equipped monster face-down when equipped to theirs.
Amaze Attraction Cyclo-Coaster sends an opponent's Spell/Trap to the GY (on yours) or searches an Amazement monster by sending itself to the GY (on theirs).

Amaze Attraction Viking Vortex bounces the equipped opposing monster when it activates an effect, Thrill Train banishes it until the End Phase or resets a GY Attraction, and Majestic Merry-Go-Round boosts ATK and protects from destruction.
Amazement Precious Park lets you activate 1 Attraction Trap the turn it is Set during each Main Phase, and sends an equipped Attraction to the GY at the End Phase to recycle or re-equip another.
